messages:
jess: FYI partner-side scan turned up base64 blobs that decoded to what looks like KMS-wrapped DB creds. found in partner-s3/2026-04-02/dump.log. tagging as potential leak :rotating_light:
security-bot: alert (detector: wrapped-creds-detected). incident INC-5421 opened and assigned to #eng-security. automatic retention copy at /secure/incidents/INC-5421/raw/.
omar: can you paste redacted blob? need to confirm wrapping format (gcloud vs aws).
jess: redacted: `CiQA...base64...==` (partner says they stored wrapped ciphertext from our earlier exchange in 2025). timestamp 2026-04-02T03:22:11Z. removed file access.
lee: initial triage: likely partner stored an old blob encrypted with key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/partner-ingest`. If that key rotated since, partner's old blobs may still decrypt with previous versions unless rewrapped. we should: 1) list which blobs we previously issued, 2) ask partner to delete stale blobs, 3) rotate DB creds and rewrap new ciphertext to partner.
infra-oncall: can schedule a 5m maintenance at 15:10 PT to rotate creds and test partner fetch flow.
omar: quick checklist for mitigation:
- revoke any DB users issued during exposed window
- create new DB user and rotate password via rotation-job
- write new creds to Vault KV (v2) and enable explicit KMS wrapping before exporting to partner
- update partner with new wrapped blob and require short TTL on wrapped-response tokens
lee: RBAC: I'll tighten the policy on `secret/data/partner/*` to deny `create` for legacy roles and require `ingest-runner-ephemeral` for read. also enabling `token_num_uses=1` for wrapped responses.
jess: enable Vault audit for that path and forward logs to secure bucket before we perform swap. sample: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/audit-partner.json` then `aws s3 cp /var/log/vault/audit-partner.json s3://redwood-secure-audit/incidents/INC-5421/`
omar: partner coordination note: their ingestion only accepts base64 ciphertext. we'll provide rewrapped base64 using current KMS key with HSM protection. will send secure link to partner and require deletion proof (md5+timestamp) once they confirm deletion of old blobs.
infra-oncall: canary swap passed at 15:16 PT. no errors.
lee: also adding a periodic job to scan partner buckets for common secret patterns and wrapped-blob markers. will open PR for the job and schedule daily run.
jess: running post-sweep grep across last 30 days for `postgres://` patterns and `wrap` markers, saving hits to /secure/incidents/INC-5421/analysis.txt.
security-bot: INC-5421 updated: status=mitigating, assignees=[jess, omar, lee], artifacts=/secure/incidents/INC-5421/, severity=medium.
omar: follow-ups: 1) require partner to rotate their storage keys quarterly, 2) enforce server-side fetch of wrapped secrets (no storing in partner logs), 3) update integration docs. I'll file follow-up tasks.
jess: thanks team. will close after 7-day post-sweep with no new exposures.
